h: Making the Heart a Lasting Dwelling for the Shechinah

p: בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ (חֵלֶק ג רלח, ב)
In the holy Zohar on this parshah (III 238b):
'If a bird's nest happens before you':
like a guest and a lodger
who happens by for the moment
That is, those who toil in Torah:
for in the time of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai
were called by the name Tanna'im.
And this is why it brought beforehand:
and your nest is set in the rock' (Bamidbar 24:21):
there is the nest of the supernal eagle,
and of her it is said (Devarim 32:11):
'As an eagle stirs up its nest,
these are those who learn halachos and mishnayos, etc."
"And there are those who, in their Mishnah,
are a dwelling for the Shechinah;
וְשָׁמְרוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת וְגוֹ׳
'And the Children of Yisrael shall keep the Shabbos, etc.,
It opened with those who learn halachos
and concluded with those who keep Shabbos "ledorosam."
בְּתַנָּא דְּבֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ (רֵישׁ סֵדֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ רַבָּה)
in Tanna D'vei Eliyahu (beginning of Seder Eliyahu Rabbah):
יָמִים יוּצָּרוּ וְלוֹ אֶחָד בָּהֶם (תְּהִלִּים קלט, טז)
"'Days were formed, and one of them is His' (Tehillim 139:16):
this is the day of Shabbos for Yisrael."
For the seven days of Creation
for the creation of the world,
and it does not say "in six"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג צד, ב)
and the main purpose of creation was
that there be a revelation of His kingship,
and this is the meaning of
"this is the day of Shabbos for Yisrael":
for then is the revelation of the glory of His kingship,
in that an entire nation accepts
the yoke of His kingship, may His Name be blessed,
And afterward it says (in Tanna D'vei Eliyahu):
"One does work all six days, etc.
אָמַר לָהֶם הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְכוּלֵּי
The Holy One, blessed is He, said to Yisrael, etc.:
אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאַתֶּם עוֹשִׂין מְלָאכָה
let Shabbos be made entirely Torah, etc."
שֶׁאֵין לוֹ מְנוּחָה לְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
"The Holy One, blessed is He, has no rest
except with those who do Torah,
וְאֶת כָּל אֵלֶּה יָדִי עָשָׂתָה וְגוֹ׳
'And all these My hand has made, etc.'"
It expounded "And where is the place of My rest"
about Shabbos, which is a day of rest.
it opened with Shabbos and concluded with those who do Torah.
But this is the essence of Shabbos for Yisrael:
that then they are all free for Torah,
according to the will of the Omnipresent
that man be only for toiling in Torah,
as it was before the corruption.
And this is why it says "the day of Shabbos for Yisrael":
that they are all free for Torah;
and as it says in the Pesikta (Rabbasi 23):
only to toil in Torah on them,"
"And you shall do all your work":
that it be as though all your work were done
are called "those who tremble at His word,"
"But to this one will I look,
to the poor and contrite of spirit,
for on Shabbos the Jew becomes
כָּל מַה שֶּׁעָבַר עָלָיו בִּימֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה
all that befell him in the days of work.
to be a dwelling for the Shechinah,
written defective, an expression of dwelling.
who are always free for Torah,
as it says in the holy Zohar
the children of the King and the Matronisa,
And here in the holy Zohar
it opened with those who toil in Torah
for then all Yisrael are called
those who toil in Torah, as stated.

p: And as for the holy Zohar's distinguishing
that there are some of them
who are a dwelling for the Shechinah permanently,
like an inn for the moment,
though it speaks of those who toil in Torah,
and why is it only for a while?
It is according to what is written
"For a mitzvah is a lamp, and Torah is light":
it explains "a mitzvah is a lamp"
as the lamp, wick and oil
and "Torah is light" is the flame.
And in the Gemara (Sotah 21a) it is explicit:
"Just as a lamp illuminates only for a time,
so too a mitzvah illuminates only for a time";
and so appears the plain sense of the pasuk,
דְּמַר אָמַר חֲדָא וּמַר אָמַר חֲדָא
that one Master said one thing and the other Master said another,
the mitzvah in its raw form,
is only like wick and oil
and the vessel of the lamp
without the light of the flame;
only the holiness from the mitzvah,
when one does it with intent
to do the will of the Creator, may He be blessed,
כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוַּנִי ה׳ אֱלֹהָי (דְּבָרִים ד, ה)
is called the "Torah is light" within the mitzvah,
and this illuminates only for a time.
of the six hundred thirteen mitzvos;
and the learning itself without intent
like a lamp, wick, and oil
which is the intent for the sake of Heaven,
that it be "as Hashem my God commanded me,"
"And enlighten our eyes in Your Torah,"
that the Name of Hashem illuminate the heart,
כִּי אֵשֵׁב בַּחֹשֶׁךְ ה׳ אוֹר לִי
"Though I sit in darkness, Hashem is a light for me":
this is the "Torah is light" within the Torah,
(and it has been explained several times).
And this is what the holy Zohar intends:
it is impossible that at least once
that he learn with the proper intent,
so that it illuminate his heart;
and then he becomes a nest and dwelling for the Shechinah;
only it is by way of happenstance,
like an inn and a lodging for the moment.
"And there are among them masters of Mishnah
from whom the Shechinah does not move
and they are a dwelling for the Shechinah permanently.
to make a dwelling for the Shechinah,
only it is for a time,
שֶׁאַחַר כָּךְ חוֹזֵר יֵצֶר הָרָע לִמְקוֹמוֹ
for afterward the yetzer hara returns to its place.
And there is one who merits the upper Shabbos,
as is expounded in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 48):
"'And the Children of Yisrael shall keep the Shabbos,
corresponding to the upper and lower Shechinah."
the upper hei and the lower hei.
"she is fear, and fear dwells in her,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א ה, ב)
עַל מִי שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם
about one who has no fear of Heaven:
רַק יֵשׁ מִי שֶׁזּוֹכֶה אַחַר כָּךְ
But there is one who merits afterward
"And the Children of Yisrael shall keep the Shabbos,"
fortunate is he who makes a dwelling for them
in the two chambers of the heart,
and the yetzer hara clears out from there";
for the upper and lower Shechinah.
"Were the Children of Yisrael to keep
and the yetzer hara clears out from there.
And there is one who merits on one Shabbos
the lower Shabbos and the upper Shabbos,
and is redeemed immediately on one Shabbos;
and this is what is said in the Midrash,
שֶׁעַל יְדֵי שַׁבָּת אֶחָד נִגְאָל מִיָּד
that through one Shabbos one is redeemed immediately.
And likewise those who toil in Torah:
now I will gather them, etc.' (Hoshea 8:10):
and if a few of them,
'they will be relieved a little from the burden of king and princes'";
that toils in Torah is redeemed.
And afterward they merit "they all study,"
that there be a permanent dwelling for the Shechinah,
and they merit the upper Shabbos;
and they will be redeemed immediately.
And so the holy Zohar counted earlier
this is the testimony of the Shechinah, etc.,
and she testifies about us before the King,
and supernal holy levels are with her, etc.;
and she is the soul over them;
it is the assistance of Heaven,
of which it is said (Melachim I 8:32):
And everywhere in the holy Zohar
the aspect of the Holy One, blessed is He,
and here it says about the Shechinah:
"of which it is said, 'And You shall hear in Heaven.'"
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (מְגִילָּה ו, ב)
"'I toiled and I found': believe it, etc.;
And the matter is as we said:
"I toiled and I found, believe it"
is said of the study of Torah,
that one merits to be a dwelling for the Shechinah
for a time, by way of happenstance,
that it enter the heart at times.
and that the words of Torah illuminate his heart,
כִּי אֵשֵׁב בַּחֹשֶׁךְ ה׳ אוֹר לִי
"Though I sit in darkness, Hashem is a light for me,"
שֶׁיָּאִיר לוֹ גַּם לְלֵב כְּסִיל לִשְׂמֹאלוֹ
that it illuminate for him even "the heart of a fool, which is at his left,"
to make a dwelling for the Shechinah
in the two chambers of the heart,
that the yetzer hara clear out from there:
the aspect of the upper Shechinah,
And this is called "assistance from Heaven":
that is, that he draws down the whole Name Havayah,
and so is called "the upper world,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק א רמז, א)
and this is why it brought about this:
"of which it is said, 'And You shall hear in Heaven.'"
And so it is with words of Torah:
that one merits the aspect of the Shechinah,
to be a dwelling only for a time;
and this all who learn halachos merit,
that it illuminate the heart at times.
וְאַחַר כָּךְ זוֹכִין לְסִיַּיעְתָּא מִן שְׁמַיָּא
And afterward one merits assistance from Heaven
that is, that it remain forever,
and the yetzer hara clears out from there,
וְכָל נֶפֶשׁ בִּפְרָט נִגְאָל מִכֹּל וָכֹל
and each individual soul is redeemed entirely;
as they said in the Gemara,
"and if they all study, now I will gather them."
every one merits the lower Shabbos,
וְיֵשׁ מִי שֶׁזּוֹכִין אַחַר כָּךְ לְשַׁבָּת עִלָּאָה
and there is one who merits afterward the upper Shabbos,
and the yetzer hara clears out from there,
and he is redeemed immediately and completely;
and were all Yisrael to keep
the lower Shabbos and the upper Shabbos,
then they would immediately be redeemed.
